title: OpenSlope billboard screens
description: The flat, video-ready screen rectangles a course's billboards carry: detected from an extracted map's placed prop geometry, or authored in Slopesmith. Every quantity is in SSX mesh space - centimetres, Z up, X negated - the same frame the bundle manifest uses.

Source.description: detected = measured from this map's prop geometry; authored = placed by hand. A detector run leaves an authored document alone.

Name.description: Unique within the document; a consumer may use it as an object name.

Family.description: What the screen sits on - a billboard model family for a detected screen, an author's grouping otherwise. Consumers group by it.

Normal.description: Unit normal pointing OUT of the screen, toward the viewer.

Up.description: Unit up direction of the image; perpendicular to Normal.

Instance.description: The Instances.json row this screen was found on, when it has one.

Page.description: The texture page the covered face draws, when the screen was measured from one.
